title: A 2006 law recognised forest dwellers' rights
sources: Scheduled Tribes and Other Traditional Forest Dwellers (Recognition of Forest Rights) Act, 2006

lines.say: Many forest dwellers had no papers for land their families had used for generations.
The Forest Rights Act changed that.

beats.say: Many forest dwellers had no papers for land their families had used for generations. The Forest Rights Act changed that.

lines.say: The Forest Rights Act was passed in 2006.
Occupation before the thirteenth of December, 2005, counts.

lines.say: Individual rights to land under cultivation,
and community rights over grazing, fishing and forest produce.
